checks.Simpson reversal: Full, evaluation and per-label results are all reported; opposing label-specific changes are explicit.
checks.Ecological inference: The unit is a benchmark moment; no inference about individual learning outcomes is made.
checks.Selected sample: Teacher-selected benchmark and deliberately chosen development groups are disclosed; no population-representative claim.
checks.Collider adjustment: No covariate adjustment or collider conditioning used.
checks.Base rates: 260/260 full labels and separate development/evaluation class denominators are reported.
checks.Regression to mean: Previously inspected examples are confined to development; modest evaluation gain is reported separately.
checks.Survivorship: All 520 final decisions and all 552 planned development decisions are retained; none excluded for performance.
checks.Multiple searching: All four candidate scores are retained; selection used development only, with one subsequent evaluation.
checks.Forking paths: One documented development revision; frozen selection before evaluation; no post-evaluation prompt changes.
checks.Causal overclaim: Observed prompt comparison only; no claim about teaching effectiveness or learning gains.
checks.Reverse causality: Not an explanatory observational causal model; static benchmark label agreement only.
